summary: Off-trail hunter in Routt County impaled by a lost broadhead-tipped arrow, presumed left over from archery hunting season; Routt County Search and Rescue extracted the hunter, who was air-evacuated by medical helicopter; condition not released; RCSAR noted it was the second such impalement in two years in Routt County.
location: Off-trail, Routt County (exact area not named)
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; medical helicopter
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE — reprint of FOX31 Denver article dated 2011-10-10 (Monday-verified) saying RCSAR "rescued a hunter last week"; pinned to 2011-10-04 (mid prior week). Fills thin year 2011. Steamboat Pilot chunk run 549; URL opened by parent.
